s.note: Yabby tails in lemon mayo on buttered soft rolls.
s.how: Chop 400g cooked yabby or bug tail meat (or cooked prawns) and mix with 4 tbsp whole egg mayonnaise, the zest and a squeeze of a lemon and chopped chives. Split and butter 8 small soft rolls, toast them lightly and fill.
shop: 400g cooked yabby, bug tail or prawn meat@Seafood

s.note: Walkabout Creek welcomes Mick home. Beef snags in white bread, fried onions, tomato sauce.
s.how: Grill 8 thick beef sausages slowly over medium heat for 15 minutes, turning often. Fry 2 sliced onions until soft and golden. Wrap each sausage in a slice of white bread with onions and a squeeze of tomato sauce.

m.note: Whole barramundi stuffed with lemon, ginger and coriander, wrapped in paperbark, cooked over coals.
m.how: Stuff a 1.5kg whole barramundi with lemon slices, a sliced knob of ginger and a bunch of coriander. Dot with 50g butter and wrap well in foil. Cook over hot coals or a hot grill for 20 minutes, turning once.

w.note: Thick pancakes under toasted macadamias and honey, a camp breakfast.
w.how: Whisk 300g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 eggs and 375ml milk into a thick batter. Cook ladlefuls in a buttered pan for 2 minutes a side. Stack and top with 80g toasted chopped macadamias and plenty of honey.

d.note: Over plenty of ice with a squeeze of lime, cold enough for the Top End.
d.how: Mix 1 tbsp caster sugar with 1 tsp ground lemon myrtle on a plate. Run lime around 4 glass rims and dip. Fill with ice, add 45ml gin and 15ml lime juice to each, then top with 150ml tonic water. Add a lime wheel.
